# System-1.5 Reasoning guide

Unofficial reading companion; source arXiv:2505.18962v3, 31 May 2025.
Authors: Xiaoqiang Wang; Suyuchen Wang; Yun Zhu; Bang Liu.
Primary source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2505.18962v3
Research contribution belongs to the authors. Original guide by 0xHayd3n with Codex assistance.

Start: README.md and AGENTS.md
Navigate: agents/README.md
Paper coverage: docs/00-reading-map.md
Mechanism: docs/02-dynamic-shortcuts.md
Training: docs/03-training-and-objectives.md
Evidence: docs/04-experiments-and-results.md
Caveats: docs/05-limitations-and-open-questions.md
Proposals: docs/06-discussion-and-reproduction.md
Notation: docs/glossary.md
Claims: metadata/claims.json
Provenance: metadata/sources.json
Table1: data/reported-results.csv
Figure4: data/test-time-scaling.csv
Citation: references/paper.bib and CITATION.cff
Validation: python scripts/validate_repository.py

Boundaries: no model reproduction, no source PDF or full extraction, no appendices in v3.
Table1 and section3.1 disagree; use table-specific values and disclose conflict.
No explicit backbone mapping per row; no hardware/timing protocol in v3.
Eq6 aligns answer positions; Eq10 target-layer text and formula disagree.
Figure4 dataset inferred from baseline; no per-cell latency.
